tldr: Moon in the 8th house routes emotional safety through shared depth and vulnerability.
body: With the Moon in the 8th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through shared resources, trust, intimacy, debt, grief, and deep repair. This makes how you merge, trust, release control, and handle what cannot stay superficial a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through shared depth and vulnerability.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in shared depth and vulnerability.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
